versions.changelog:
Version 3.1.0 introduces stricter invocation controls and explicit user confirmation for live trading actions.

- Added explicit declaration that user confirmation is required before starting or creating any trading deployment.
- Defined invocation mode as "user-confirmed" for enhanced operational safety.
- No logic, feature, or endpoint changes; documentation and metadata updates only.

Version 3.0.9

- Updated documentation to clarify user experience guidelines: prefer user-friendly language over technical details unless requested by the user.
- Added an explicit statement that the platform uses Freqtrade for strategy execution on Hyperliquid, to be shared only if users ask about underlying technology.
- Removed instructions to never mention the underlying engine; now, transparency is encouraged if users are curious.
- Minor clarifications to API key setup and environment usage.
- No functional or API changes.

No user-facing changes detected in this version.

- Version and content remain the same as the previous release.
- No file changes or new features introduced.

Major update includes simplified structure, improved documentation, and security clarifications.

- Refactored skill documentation for clarity; moved to a single unified file and removed phase-based sub-skills.
- Expanded and clarified user onboarding steps and security rules.
- Updated credential and wallet explanations to reflect platform-managed architecture; clarified agent vs. main wallet roles.
- Enhanced safety instructions for live deployment, now requiring explicit user confirmation with clearer warnings.
- Revised environment variable usage and external endpoint descriptions for accuracy and transparency.
- Improved language for anti-hallucination, anti-leakage, and verification behavior.

- No user-visible changes in this release.
- Version bump only; no code or documentation updates detected.
No changes detected in this release.

Version 2.0.7

- No file changes detected in this release.
- Functionality and behavior remain unchanged from the previous version.

- No user-facing changes in this release.
- Version updated for internal tracking.

Major update — introduces a router architecture with strict security and operational rules.

- Added a routing layer to dynamically load phase-specific sub-skills (auth setup, strategy builder, backtesting, deployment, monitoring) based on user intent.
- Enforced strong, always-active security controls and credential handling; prohibits private key requests or leaks.
- Requires verification-by-API-call for all factual statements (never assume, always check).
- Clarifies agent behavior: operates conversationally, shows raw API responses only on request, guides users contextually.
- Handles repeated task failures by summarizing attempts, suggesting alternatives, and recommending model switches if needed.

- Added explicit API authentication fields (`primaryEnv`, `auth`, `externalEndpoints`) to SKILL.md for clarity on credential handling and endpoint usage.
- Listed all external endpoints with their purposes, including Hyperliquid wallet balance checks.
- No changes to business logic, usage instructions, or core agent/skill functionality.
- Primarily an internal update to metadata in SKILL.md for improved integration and transparency.

**Credential management and onboarding process updated for enhanced security and automation.**

- Users must add their API key as the `SUPERIOR_TRADE_API_KEY` environment variable; pasting keys into chat is not permitted.
- Agent now reads the API key automatically from the environment and will never ask users to paste it during conversation.
- Instructions for obtaining and providing the API key are updated to reflect secure onboarding requirements.
- No changes to trading logic, feature set, or API endpoints.

**Major update with new workflow and clarity for wallet handling and user guidance:**

- Introduced explicit agent wallet vs. main wallet architecture and clarified balance checking and funding procedures.
- Updated API key acquisition instructions—now directs users only to https://account.superior.trade with step-by-step onboarding.
- Added strict "verification-first" rule: all balances and deployment health must be confirmed by live API call before reporting.
- Clarified allowed/disallowed agent actions and enhanced transparency requirements for live bot deployments.
- Refined formatting and guidance for HIP3 (tokenized assets) trading pairs, including hyphen usage and correct configuration.
- Improved anti-hallucination guidance: agents must never infer balances or deployment results—every claim needs real API verification.

- Added primary_credential and env sections specifying the API key requirements.
- Updated API key documentation for clarity and to match new configuration format.
- No changes to API logic or functional behavior; this release improves credential/environment variable definitions and documentation structure.

- Added explicit credentials section, specifying the required API key and its scope.
- Clarified credential requirements and usage in the description.
- No changes to core functionality or API usage; documentation only.

- Updated homepage and login instructions from app.superior.trade to account.superior.trade.
- Clarified where users obtain their API key (now through the account portal).
- No functional or API changes—documentation only.

- Adds homepage and source metadata fields to the skill for greater discoverability.
- Updates the description and credential guidance to clarify: only an API key is required, never private keys or wallet credentials; all key management is server-side.
- Introduces a deployment summary/confirmation step before starting any live trading, ensuring explicit user consent for trades with real funds.
- Improves transparency: agent must show raw API requests/payloads if the user asks.
- Clarifies security, permissions, and agent behavior requirements for safer, more user-friendly operation.
- No functional or code changes; documentation and user experience improvements only.

- New major version of the superior-trade-api skill for interacting with the Superior Trade API (cloud backtesting and live deployment of algorithmic trading strategies; no user coding required)
- Adds interactive, conversational agent behaviors — builds config/strategy, runs backtests, monitors deployment, and gathers user info step by step
- Supports Hyperliquid spot, futures, and HIP3 tokenized assets (incl. US stocks, metals, commodities, FX, indices via different protocols)
- Strict policy: all balance, account state, and deployment info must be verified via live API calls in the current session before reporting to the user
- Credentials and wallet management are automated via the API; users do not handle exchange keys or wallet addresses manually
- Enhanced backtesting and deployment flow, with proactive result interpretation (e.g. warns on negative backtest profit before offering live deployment)
